lines.en: Bia, close the door. She is not supposed to know yet, and she walks past this office every morning.
lines.pt: Bia, feche a porta. Ela não deve saber ainda, e passa por este escritório toda manhã.

lines.en: Right. Our colleague is supposed to think that the meeting on Friday is just an ordinary lunch, correct?
lines.pt: Certo. Nossa colega deve achar que a reunião de sexta é só um almoço comum, certo?

lines.en: Exactly. Everybody is supposed to arrive at noon, and the cake is supposed to be hidden in the kitchen until she comes in.
lines.pt: Exato. Todos devem chegar ao meio-dia, e o bolo deve ficar escondido na cozinha até ela entrar.

lines.en: Who is supposed to keep her busy while we decorate? Somebody has to take her out for coffee.
lines.pt: Quem deve mantê-la ocupada enquanto decoramos? Alguém tem que levá-la para tomar café.

lines.en: Her manager was supposed to do that, but he forgot, and now he is travelling until Thursday night.
lines.pt: O gerente dela devia fazer isso, mas esqueceu, e agora está viajando até quinta à noite.

lines.en: Typical. Then I will do it, although I’m not very good at keeping secrets, and I blush when I lie.
lines.pt: Típico. Então eu faço, embora eu não seja muito boa em guardar segredos e fique vermelha quando minto.

lines.en: Then say as little as possible. And remember, the invitation was supposed to stay in the group chat, not in an email.
lines.pt: Então fale o mínimo possível. E lembre-se, o convite devia ficar no grupo, não em um e-mail.

lines.en: Oh no. I sent it to the whole team by mistake. If she checks her inbox, she will see everything.
lines.pt: Ah, não. Mandei para a equipe toda por engano. Se ela olhar a caixa de entrada, vai ver tudo.

lines.en: Don’t panic. I’m going to ask the assistant to recall the message, and we will pretend that nothing happened.
lines.pt: Não entre em pânico. Vou pedir à assistente para recolher a mensagem, e vamos fingir que nada aconteceu.

lines.en: Good plan. By the way, we’re supposed to pay for the gift by Wednesday, so I have already collected the money.
lines.pt: Bom plano. A propósito, devemos pagar o presente até quarta, então já recolhi o dinheiro.

lines.en: Excellent. Let’s hope she isn’t suspicious, because this surprise will only work if nobody can give away the plan.
lines.pt: Excelente. Vamos torcer para ela não desconfiar, porque esta surpresa só funciona se ninguém puder entregar o plano.

facts.label: Segredos e planos
facts.sub: She isn’t supposed to know. Everybody is supposed to arrive at noon.

facts.label: isn’t supposed to
facts.sub: Use isn’t/aren’t supposed to para o que alguém não deve saber ou fazer: She isn’t supposed to know yet. Aqui é um combinado entre as pessoas, não uma regra do governo.

facts.label: is/are supposed to
facts.sub: Use is/are supposed to para o que cada um deve fazer no plano: Everybody is supposed to arrive at noon. Em português, “todos devem chegar ao meio-dia”.

pages.title: A secret in the office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey morning in Seattle. Fay shuts the office door quietly. Bia carries a bag of balloons. A coloured card lies on the desk. They speak in low voices. Nobody else is in the room.

“Bia, close the door. She is not supposed to know yet, and she walks past this office every morning.” says Fay. “Right. Our colleague is supposed to think that the meeting on Friday is just an ordinary lunch, correct?” says Bia. “Exactly. Everybody is supposed to arrive at noon, and the cake is supposed to be hidden in the kitchen until she comes in.” says Fay.
